tagline: Poems and stories about love, healing and coming home to yourself
heroHeading: Words for the days you need them most.
heroText: Six small books about love, healing and finding your way back to yourself. Read a page, keep a line, order a copy straight from the author.
aboutBody:
I write the way some people keep a diary: quietly, late at night, with the window open. My books began as notes on my phone — a line from a train ride, a sentence overheard at a tea stall, a feeling I could not name until I wrote it down.

I believe a book does not have to be loud to be honest. The pieces here are short on purpose, so you can read one on a bus, one before sleep, and carry one into the next day.

Every copy is packed and shipped by hand from my own store, and every message from a reader is answered personally.
shortBio: I write short, honest books about love, healing and the slow work of becoming yourself. They are made to be read in small pieces, on ordinary days.
statement: If one line from these pages stays with you through a hard week, the book has done its job.
writingJourney:
It started with a notebook and a habit of writing three lines every night.

Those lines grew into small collections that friends asked to borrow, then to keep.

Today the books are printed in small batches, so each run can be improved before the next one.
influences: The rhythm of everyday speech, letters between friends, old film songs, and the quiet writers who prove a short sentence can hold a whole afternoon.
insideBooks:
These books are written in plain, warm language — no puzzles to solve, no pretending. Each piece is short enough to read in a minute and strong enough to stay for a week.

You will find love that is gentle rather than dramatic, healing that takes its time, and reflections on growing up, leaving, returning and starting again.

They are for anyone who reads at the end of the day, for readers who underline, and for people who want to gift a small book that says what they could not.
